(Network is public - fetching or installing at start is not a defect.)'; Internal Quality Checks!D20 adds 'no network / no run-time install', which the reference also satisfies). Skill references/quality-checks.md:83-85 procedure applied by hand.
SOLVE.SH (task/solution/solve.sh, sha256 1df2ed04...030a, matches raw-evidence-index): '#!/bin/bash' + 'set -euo pipefail', LF only (0 CR bytes in solution/), mkdir -p /app; 'cp -a "$(dirname "$0")/app/." /app/'; removes $DB_PATH(+-wal/-shm) only after realpath check that it is under /app; writes nothing to /tests, /logs/verifier or /solution; no pkill, no NODE_ENV, no npm install. Its node /proc scan exits 0 immediately on a fresh install (no db files) so it cannot block the oracle. Template solve.sh is the plain mkdir+cp; the task adds only a guarded fresh-baseline reset, which matches instruction.md:17 'start with no shipped database'.
RUNTIME CONTRACT (instruction.md:15, integration.md:3-10): server.js:2 require('./src/index.js'); bootstrap.js:39-43 answers GET /api/health in the main thread before the SQLite worker starts, listens on Number(process.env.PORT||3000) on 0.0.0.0 (bootstrap.js:62); worker gets PORT 0 and binds 127.0.0.1 only (index.js:447) and is reached via in-process proxy, SSE /api/events streams through the pipe. db.js:9 DB_PATH = process.env.DB_PATH || /app/app.db (worker inherits process.env, bootstrap.js:64). Seeding idempotent: db.js:61-62 returns if users exist; whole seed in one transaction. Uses only express, better-sqlite3 (package.json, both preinstalled in environment/Dockerfile and tests/Dockerfile at the same pins) and node built-ins.
SELF-CONTAINED: seed read from solution/app/src/seed_data.json (byte-identical to environment/assets/seed_data.json, sha256 a1c65c80...3740), so no /assets dependency at runtime (instruction.md:17 '/assets and /instructions are unavailable at runtime'); index.html loads only /styles.css and /js/*.js, no off-origin URL anywhere in public/ or src/; no symlinks (test.sh symlink guard passes); no shipped app.db.
TEMPLATE/TIMEOUTS: test.sh, tests/Dockerfile, environment/Dockerfile, score.py, restart_mcp.py identical to frozen template; task.toml diff vs template only in identity/metadata; agent 7200 / verifier 13200 / build 600 unchanged (no timeout change to justify).
